findings.message: The slice `rows[start : start + size + 1]` returns `size + 1` users per page instead of `size`. Each page also repeats the first user of the next page.
findings.suggestion: return [User(r["id"], r["email"], r["name"]) for r in rows[start : start + size]]

findings.message: Every call now fetches the whole users table into memory and slices it in Python, where before the database applied LIMIT/OFFSET. Memory use and latency grow with table size on every page request, so keep the parameterised `LIMIT ? OFFSET ?` query.
